displayName: DiamondEcho SRE: TLS certificate expires within 14 days

documentation.subject: DiamondEcho: a certificate is close to expiry and has not been renewed
documentation.content:
The uptime check of the API reports that the certificate it was served expires in less than 14 days. Google renews the run.app certificate on its own; one this close to expiry means renewal has stopped. When it expires, the calculators and the contact form stop working in visitors' browsers. (Only the API is checked from here. The certificates of diamondecho.com and staff.diamondecho.com are watched by the GitHub monitor alone.)

The GitHub monitor warns earlier (21 days, scripts/sre/checks/tls.mjs); this is the independent backstop.

What to do: follow docs/sre/runbooks/tls-certificate.md.

This message carries no visitor data.
